strongest_angle: Investigate how forensic investigators utilized luminol to uncover hidden human DNA at an Olney property on West Chew Avenue, advancing the ongoing missing persons and homicide inquiry.

key_facts.fact: Investigators sprayed luminol and discovered human DNA inside a house on West Chew Avenue in Philadelphia's Olney neighborhood.
Philadelphia police and the FBI excavated large portions of the property at 417 W. Chew Ave. as part of a search tied to missing women.
Investigators previously seized lab equipment and chemicals from the basement of the Philadelphia house during their ongoing inquiry.
Federal and local teams utilized luminol inside the Olney home while working into the evening on Monday.
